name: Ochertay Bay-Glebovka UKPG Gas Pipeline, second string
monitor_reason: concrete step: no current sponsor or step. The only step is a 2014 report (pipes ordered by Chornomornaftogaz, then the Ukrainian state operator); the 2015 Russian territorial plan lists the string with no sponsor, no award and no date, and build status is unconfirmed. Length passes (43.65 km sourced, over 25 km).
researcher_notes: No match to an existing GEM row (checked the Ukraine roster in discovery_context; no Glebovka, Ochertay or Crimea trunk row). Separate pipe from the first Ochertay-Glebovka string, which is folded into holitsynske-hlibivka. Facts found: a March 2014 neftegaz.ru report says a parallel Ocheretay-Glebovka line of 42.5 km will be laid and the pipes are already ordered. Item 292 of Annex 4 to Russian government order 816-r (sudact.ru, current text) lists the second string at 43.65 km, 700 mm, 5.4 MPa, Chernomorsky district, gas to the Glebovka storage. Both pages load and name the pipeline. They do not say who sponsors it now or whether it was built. A web search found no later report of construction or commissioning. The two sources are different publishers but the plan is a planning list, not a construction step. If built, any Russian builder would be reported as builder only; the line is wholly inside occupied Ukraine (Crimea), so it would be a Ukraine row. Re-check if a source confirms construction or a contract. Do not stage values yet.
